verdict.rationale: Stable publishes a per-endpoint API reference under docs.usestable.com/reference, covering authentication, companies, locations, and onboarding sessions. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a public OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.
